decision_conditions: The works have not been described in measurable or quantifiable terms, as required by Government Guidance.  Clear measurements (e.g., pre and post work height/width reductions) are required to ensure the Local Planning Authority can assess the impact. Please resubmit with an appropriate specification. For example: 2m crown reduction in width and 2m reduction in height, leaving a canopy spread of 3m and height of 5m. Please refer to the Council’s guidance for full details.
description:
Lime tree located along the left boundary wall facing Hatherley Road
1) Thin crown
2) reduce crown by 1/3 - 40%
3) remove dead/dying branches
A few small branches seem to have died but the rest have a lot of leaves that fall on the asbestos garage roof on neighbouring property, and our flat roof extension causing issues with guttering and rainfall retention on the roofing. Excess leaves and rainwater falling from
leaves have also caused substantial rotting to the decking directly beneath the tree

Previous owners successfully applied for 1/3 crown reduction previously and tree has grown in 3 years since.
